SEARCH

Uses of Package
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social

Packages that use com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social
Social login (identity brokering) through external identity providers: Google, Microsoft Entra ID, Apple and GitHub.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social
Use cases of social login (identity brokering): resolving a sign-in with an external provider to an account (finding it, linking by verified e-mail address, or provisioning it), linking, unlinking and listing the identities of an account.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.x509
Use cases of X.509 client certificate sign-in: resolving a certificate fingerprint to an account, binding a certificate to an account and unbinding it.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social
Social login (identity brokering): the identities of external providers linked to an account, the providers supported, how far a provider's multi-factor claim is trusted, and the port that stores the links.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.github
GitHub adapter of the authorization server: the verified e-mail port of the social login, implemented with the REST client generated from apis/github/rest-server/github-api-v1.yaml.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.social
JDBC adapters of social login: the identities of external providers linked to accounts, the mark of the accounts that only hold a generated password, and the Jackson module of the federated principals.
  • Classes in com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social used by com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social
    Class
    Description
    FederatedIdentity
    An identity of an external provider linked to a local account: the account is reached by presenting the provider's stable subject, never by its e-mail address, which a provider may change.
    FederatedIdentityNotFoundException
    Thrown when an account has no linked identity with the requested identifier.
    IdentityProvider
    External identity providers an account can be linked to.
    LastSignInMethodException
    Thrown when removing a sign-in method would leave the account with none, so its owner could never sign in again.
    ProviderTrust
    How far a provider's own multi-factor authentication is trusted.
    VerifiedEmailLookup
    Port that asks an external provider for the verified primary e-mail address of the user who just signed in, for a provider whose profile does not vouch for its e-mail address (GitHub).
  • Classes in com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social used by com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social
    Class
    Description
    FederatedIdentity
    An identity of an external provider linked to a local account: the account is reached by presenting the provider's stable subject, never by its e-mail address, which a provider may change.
    FederatedIdentityRepository
    Port that stores the identities of external providers linked to accounts.
    FederatedLinkingPolicy
    Rules of identity brokering: when an external identity may be tied to an account, and when it may be removed.
    GeneratedPasswordRepository
    Port that remembers which accounts only hold a password the server generated and nobody knows: the accounts created by the first sign-in with an external provider.
    IdentityProvider
    External identity providers an account can be linked to.
    SignInMethods
    The ways an account can sign in with.
    SignInMethodsLock
    Port that serializes the removals of the sign-in methods of one account (unlinking an identity, unbinding a certificate), so that two concurrent removals cannot each count the other's method as remaining and together leave the account with no way to sign in.
